description_en: Queries the storage overview information of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster, such as the total data size, hot data size, cold data size, and data growth
description_zh: 查看实例的空间概览信息，包括总数据量、热数据量、冷数据量、数据增长量等
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-space-summary --db-cluster-id am-bp1u8c0mgfg580000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterSpaceSummary

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region.
